# Literal-Safe Composition

When generating shell or config through pipelines, preserve literals exactly—quoting and escaping matter.

## Mechanism switching

If a write path corrupts content once, change mechanism rather than retrying identically.

## Prefer proven channels

Use editor tools or structured writes when heredocs and echo chains historically mangled bytes.

## Verify encoding

When non-ASCII appears, confirm the consumer sees the intended characters after round-trip.
